_readme: Exp-3 Aerodynamic Analysis. 'chasis'/'motor'/'esc'/'battery'/'controller'/'reciever'/'attachments' are folder-driven catalog categories exactly like the reference platform (drop a folder with spec.json + model, list it below). The propeller is NOT a category — it is generated procedurally from the 'airfoils' table + the Blade Geometry sliders (see js/main.js buildProceduralProp). 'airfoils' is a flat physics table (m,p,t,cl_max_ref,a_stall_ref,re_ref); alpha0 is computed at load time from the camber-line integral, never stored here.

instructor.text: Welcome to the Aerodynamic Analysis lab. We will profile a NACA airfoil in a virtual wind tunnel, then mount that same blade section on a propeller and study forward-flight drag and cruise efficiency.
Module 1 · Airfoil Lab — pick a NACA airfoil in Input Parameters and sweep the Angle of Attack slider. Watch the Cl curve build in the live graph as stall approaches.
Run the Airfoil Polar experiment — it sweeps AoA automatically from below zero-lift to past stall, plotting Cl and Cd the whole way.
Watch the wind tunnel closely near the top of the sweep — separated flow and turbulent streamlines appear once the airfoil stalls.
Profile a few different NACA sections and compare their polars overlaid in the Charts panel — thinner symmetric sections stall later but lift less; cambered sections lift more but stall earlier.
Module 2 · Forward Flight unlocks once Module 1 is complete. The same airfoil now forms the procedural propeller blade on the assembled drone in the wind tunnel.
Toggle Rotor Wash on the Operating Point card — it raises the effective drag coefficient the way a spinning rotor disturbs the airflow over the frame.
Run Frame Drag — it sweeps airspeed and fits a line through F_D vs V², confirming the quadratic drag law with a live R² value.
Cruise Efficiency sweeps airspeed up to the zero-thrust advance ratio and tracks propulsive efficiency versus advance ratio J.
Efficiency should rise, peak somewhere around J ≈ 0.5, then fall back toward zero as the propeller windmills — that peak is the propeller's best cruise point.
Excellent — every experiment is complete. The Propeller Blade Profile reward is now unlocked in the Outputs panel.
